_comment: Gabarito of the business rules planted in sample-project/billing. Used by rules tests and the quality evaluation (step 7). Per rule: every inner list in 'keywords' must be matched by at least one of its alternatives (lowercase fragments) in a correct explanation.

rules.summary: Volume discount by quantity tier (>=10: 5%, >=50: 10%, >=100: 15%); none for orders under 20.
Credit is refused when more than 90 days overdue; customers under 6 months are capped at 500; balance plus amount must stay within the limit.
VAT rate depends on region (mainland 23/13/6, Madeira 22/12/5, Azores 16/9/4) and product category (reduced for food and books, intermediate for restaurants).
Portuguese NIF: 9 digits, first digit not 0/4/7/8, mod-11 check digit.
Returns: perishables never; electronics only unopened within 30 days; everything else within 14 days.
